#Blueface , Born Johnathan Jamall Porter, Is A Los Angeles Rapper, Songwriter, And Internet Personality Who Rose To Fame In 2018 With His Breakout Hit “Thotiana.” Known For His Unique Offbeat Flow, Viral Personality, And West Coast Sound, Blueface Quickly Became One Of The Most Talked-About Names In Hip-Hop. In Recent Years, He Has Also Built A Following Through Livestreaming And His Highly Publicized Relationships With Jaidyn Alexis, Chrisean Rock, And Nevaeh Akira.

Nevaeh Akira, Also Known As Nevaeh Akirah, Is A Social Media Influencer And Internet Personality Who Gained Widespread Attention Through Her On-And-Off Relationship With Blueface. The Two Welcomed A Baby Boy, Johnathan Jamall Porter Jr., In August 2026. Their Relationship Has Frequently Made Headlines Due To Public Breakups, Reconciliations, And Viral Livestream Moments. XXL Mag +1

Nevaeh Is Also The Mother Of A Son Named Superior From Her Previous Relationship With DJ LetThemKnow, Whose Real Name Is Robert Louis Lee. In August 2026, DJ LetThemKnow Filed Court Papers Seeking Joint Legal And Physical Custody Of Superior. Their Ongoing Custody Dispute Has Since Attracted Attention Across Social Media, Adding Another Chapter To Nevaeh’s Highly Publicized Personal Life. TMZ +1
